quests.title: Force Start

quests.summary: Contact with the Hub Base is lost; Perlica and the Endministrator restore power to Valley IV and push the Landbreakers out of the Valley Fort.

quests.summary: With the bridge to the Power Plateau gone, the team looks for another route while repairs on Dijiang continue.

quests.summary: The route to the Power Plateau leads through the Blight-choked Originium Science Park and the Origin Lodespring.

parts.note: Listed as "Cradle of Ages" by PowerPyx; datamine name used.

quests.title: Process IV
quests.summary: On the Power Plateau the team heads for the Æther Test Site under the rift, then the factions of Valley IV meet to plan what comes next.

parts.title: Work Preparation II
parts.note: Datamine name is "Work Preparation" (e5m0d5); a short prep step before Chapter 2.

quests.title: Process I
quests.summary: The expedition sets out for Wuling, gets separated in a limestone cave and meets Tangtang of Qingbo Stockade.
quests.start: Follows Chapter 1 Process IV; Fiona calls you back to Dijiang.

quests.title: Process II
quests.summary: In Wuling City the team meets Viceroy Zhuang Fangyi and begins Xiranite research and production with the Tianshi.

parts.title: Ready the Easterlies
parts.note: Listed as "A Breeze Away" by PowerPyx at launch; current in-game name per datamine.

quests.title: Process V
quests.summary: Wuling City braces for an attack, and the team works with Zhuang Fangyi to reinforce the Tianshi Pillar Array.
quests.start: Follows Process IV; go to the Main Pillar Office.

parts.title: Thus Rise the Wave and Wind
